action_sequences: A hand picks up the blue hexagonalprism and then places it into the white bowl.
A hand picks up the green cuboid and then places it in front of the purple triangularprism.
A hand picks up the purple triangularprism and then places it to the left of the green cuboid.
A hand picks up the red cylinder and then places it to the right of the white bowl.
code:
blue_hexagonalprism_pos = getpos('blue hexagonalprism')
moveto(blue_hexagonalprism_pos)
pick()
white_bowl_into = getpos('white bowl', 'into')
moveto(white_bowl_into)
place()
